title: Were the Rats Innocent?
sentences: For centuries, rats took the blame for the Black Death.
But the plague moved faster than rats could carry it.
In 2018, researchers modeled outbreaks in nine European cities.
In most of them, human fleas and body lice explained the spread better than rats.
The killer was still the same bacterium.
But it may have traveled from person to person.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
caption:
For centuries, rats took the blame. Some scientists now think people and their fleas spread it faster.
